card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS warning words
card.fires_on: The first or middle piece of a long word written in capital letters, mostly in boxed warnings and headings, where the next piece continues the word (TH|ROMBOTIC, EN|H|ANCES, IM|BAL|ANCE).

modes.label: Start of capitalized word
modes.description: The opening piece of a long uppercase word in a warning heading.

modes.label: Middle of capitalized word
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase word that is split into several parts.
modes.example: OR ELECTROLYTE IM<<BAL>>ANCE IS MANIFESTED, MOTOF

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the next capitalized piece of the word, such as OLF, ANEL or REET, and away from lowercase endings.
card.plain: It fires partway through long words typed in all capitals, as in boxed warnings, and helps finish the word.
